lineWrapping.description: Line wrapping mode inside the code editor (`"off"`, `"auto"`, or a column width; `"auto"` by default).

LanguageConfig.description: Language server and Mise tool preset for a single programming language.

args.description: Command-line arguments passed to the language server executable.

command.description: Executable name or path for the language server.

default_tasks.description: Default Mise tasks synthesized when this language is detected in a workspace.

enabled.description: Whether this language preset is active.

env.description: Extra environment variables passed to the language server process.

extensions.description: File extensions (without leading dots) mapped to this language.

initialization_options.description: Optional JSON payload forwarded as `initializationOptions` during the LSP `initialize` handshake.

mise_tools.description: Mise tool specifications required to run this language server.

root_markers.description: Marker files or directories that identify the language's project root.

anyOf.description: Wrap lines automatically at the editor viewport width (`auto`).
Fixed character column width at which lines wrap.

LineWrap.description: Line wrapping mode persisted under `editor.lineWrapping` (`"off"`, `"auto"`, or a column width).

LspSettingsPatch.description: Sparse LSP settings overrides persisted under `lsp.*` in `config.json`.

autoInstall.description: Whether missing language server binaries should be installed via `mise install`.

enabled.description: Whether LSP integration is enabled for workspaces.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration in milliseconds to wait for an LSP JSON-RPC response.

anyOf.description: Detailed task with an optional description and shell command.

MiseTaskConfig.description: A default Mise task definition for a language preset, represented as either a shell string or a detailed record.

ThemeMode.description: Supported color theme preferences persisted under `appearance.theme`.

oneOf.description: Follow the operating system color scheme.

activeRoot.description: Last active workspace root directory path.

recentRoots.description: Recently opened workspace root directory paths.

description: Sparse nested configuration document persisted in `~/.lgtm/config.json` and `<workspace>/.lgtm/config.json`.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference URI for editor intelligence.

languages.description: Per-language LSP server and Mise toolchain overrides keyed by language ID (`languages.*`).

lsp.description: Partial LSP lifecycle and timeout overrides (`lsp.*`).

title: LgtmConfigPatch
